_about: A made-up pitch that uses every slide kind. The company, numbers and sources are placeholders: copy the shape, not the facts. Pictures that don't exist show as grey PHOTO boxes until you add them.
title: Kibo pitch

references.author: Health Office
references.title: Cold chain survey of rural clinics.

references.author: Kibo
references.title: Field test of three boxes over ten days.

slides.notes:
Ana · about 10 s
Good afternoon. We're Kibo: Ana, Ben and Chi.

slides.text:
A vaccine is only as good
as its last cold mile.
slides.notes:
Ana · about 12 s
Every vaccine has to stay between two and eight degrees, all the way to the child.

Ana · about 15 s
In the clinics we surveyed, one dose in four spoils on the way.

If asked how it was measured: temperature loggers in 40 cool boxes over one month.

slides.caption: A district in the survey
slides.notes:
Ana · about 12 s
The nearest fridge is six hours away, and each clinic has one cool box.

slides.text:
Today's cool boxes
melt by noon.
slides.notes:
Ben · about 10 s
The ice packs in today's boxes are water by midday.

slides.text: Kibo keeps them cold for five days.
slides.notes:
Ben · about 8 s
This is Kibo. It keeps three hundred doses cold for five days, with no power.

steps.head: Charge it in the sun.
steps.notes:
Ben · about 8 s
It works in three steps. First, it charges in the sun,

steps.head: Load the doses.
steps.notes:
Ben · about 5 s
then the nurse loads the doses,

steps.head: Carry it out.
steps.notes:
Ben · about 6 s
and carries it out on foot or by bike.

slides.label: What powers it

columns.head: The lid.
columns.tail: A solar panel that recharges it.

slides.notes:
Chi · about 15 s
Inside are cells that melt at four degrees, recharged by a panel in the lid.

slides.label: Field test
slides.notes:
Chi · about 12 s
We ran three boxes for ten days. Not one dose went warm.

slides.text: We start with vaccines. Then everything cold.
slides.notes:
Chi · about 12 s
We start with vaccines. The same box carries insulin, blood and samples.

Ana · about 10 s
Three asks: pilot with us, mentor us, and fund the first fifty boxes.

The QR code opens our page.

Ana · about 5 s
Thank you. Any questions?
